preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The number of roads m is between n-1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= n and 1 <= y_i <= n and x_i != y_i for x_i, y_i in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road connects two distinct cities, each numbered between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of road connections matches the given m.

postconditions.description: The output contains n-1 integers, one for each city except the first city.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= r < 10**9 + 7 for r in result)
postconditions.description: Each result is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: result[i] == min_number_mod_10_9_7(i + 2) for i in range(n - 2)
postconditions.description: Each result[i] is the smallest number Koala could have written for destination i+2, modulo 10^9 + 7.
